definitions.explanation: A district of Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, where most of the national government ministries have their offices. By metonymy it means the central bureaucracy and its career officials, as distinct from the elected politicians of {永田町|ながたちょう}.

examples.japanese: {霞|かすみ}が{関|せき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
{霞|かすみ}が{関|せき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Kasumigaseki bureaucrats work a lot of overtime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧⟦{中身|なかみ}→中身：01483_nakami⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{霞|かすみ}が{関|せき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}めている→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the details of the new system are actually decided by the bureaucracy.

notes:
Also written {霞ヶ関|かすみがせき}; the subway station is {霞ケ関|かすみがせき}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {霞|かすみ}が{関|せき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧: central government bureaucrats
- {霞|かすみ}が{関|せき}⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧: bureaucratese, vague official wording that leaves room for interpretation
- ⟦{永田町|ながたちょう}→永田町：31030_nagatachou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{霞|かすみ}が{関|せき}: politicians and bureaucrats, the two halves of national government

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{官界|かんかい}→官界：24371_kankai⟧: bureaucratic circles — the plain common noun
- ⟦{永田町|ながたちょう}→永田町：31030_nagatachou⟧: national politics — the elected side of government
